description: This file defines a test class 'MarkBasedTest' which extends 'DispatcherTest'. It contains setup and getter methods related to dispatcher and data generator classes within the 'FastRoute' namespace, specifically for testing 'MarkBased' dispatcher functionality.

classes.name: MarkBasedTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the 'MarkBased' dispatcher in the 'FastRoute' routing library.

methods.name: setUp
